subject: Vendor onboarding: PO mapping, split-invoice request & net term alignment
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <ewalsh@fleetops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@fleetops.com
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FleetOps vendor activation — PO routing & billing cadence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. FleetOps is gearing up to integrate Redwood as a preferred inference provider for our new Fleet AI product line. Weve completed the initial legal review and procurement team has two questions we need resolved before we can activate the vendor record:

1) PO and invoicing: Can Redwood accept a single PO that references multiple SOWs / milestone lines and allow split invoices per milestone? Our standard procurement flow likes to submit one PO with line-level milestone dates.

2) Billing cadence / net terms: Our AR operates on a Net60 cycle, but wed like to know if theres flexibility — specifically whether Redwood can do Net45 or Net30, and whether you offer an early-pay/discount program (we could enroll in that if it helps).

Ive attached FleetOps_Onboarding_Form.pdf and a current W-9 for your vendor intake team. Please let us know what additional fields you need on the PO header and whether theres any onboarding checklist we should complete to speed this up.

Best,
Erin Walsh
Head of Procurement, FleetOps Inc.
ewalsh@fleetops.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- FleetOps_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
- W9_FleetOps.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <ewalsh@fleetops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FleetOps vendor activation — PO routing & billing cadence

Hi Erin,

Appreciate the quick send and the attachments. A few clarifying items so Finance and Vendor Ops can put this through cleanly: 

- PO / split invoices: We can accept a single PO that references multiple SOW line items, but split invoicing needs consistent line-item IDs and milestone dates. In practice we map each invoice to a PO line and a milestone code so our AP routing is deterministic. Can you confirm whether your PO generator includes line-level milestone dates and a consistent PR/PO number per contract?

- Net terms: Redwoods default for new vendors is Net45. We offer two alternatives depending on your preference:
  * Option A: Standard onboarding (Net45) — no additional setup.
  * Option B: Accelerated remit (Net30) — finance can enable this as a 6-month pilot if you enroll in our early-pay program. That program includes a small discount (we typically offer 0.75%-1%) to cover the accelerate.

- Required vendor fields: remit-to (ACH + postal), legal business name, tax ID/EIN, invoice header format, and a point-of-contact for invoice disputes. If you can provide ACH details and confirm the invoice header format we can move faster.

Next steps I propose: Marissa (ccd) will validate the discount pilot and DocuSign process. If youre good with a pilot we can schedule a 30-min PO-mapping call early next week to capture the milestone mappings and PO field expectations.

Also linking our vendor portal where you can pre-fill the onboarding form: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/FL-2026-0423

Thanks — Ill wait for your PO sample or a screen of the PO export so we can confirm line-mapping.

—Karthik
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Erin — looping in Redwood Finance / Vendor Ops.

Short version from our side: default is Net45; we can run an accelerated remit pilot (Net30) with a 1% early-pay discount for an initial 6-month period. Requirements to enable accelerated remit:

- Signed vendor onboarding / SLA (well send a DocuSign)
- Completed onboarding form in the vendor portal (legal name, EIN/tax id, remit-to ACH + bank confirmation)
- PO header must include a single PO number and line-level item IDs; invoices must reference the PO number and the associated milestone ID.

DocuSign for onboarding and the PO template are here: https://docusign.com/FL-2026-0423-PO-template
We will also need a sample invoice export (CSV or PDF) from FleetOps so Vendor Ops can validate the line-mapping.

If FleetOps agrees to the 1% early-pay discount and provides ACH details, we can fast-track Net30 and provision auto-ack for PO receipts.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — that all works for us. Confirmations: 

- FleetOps can supply the ACH remit info and a signed W-9 (attached).
- We can adopt the 1% early-pay discount for Net30 for the initial 6-month pilot.
- Our PO export includes line-level milestone dates and a consistent PO number per contract; Ill attach a sample invoice export and a screen grab of a PO so you can validate line mapping.

One ask: can Redwood auto-ack incoming POs and include the PO number in the AP ticket to avoid manual routing? That would be very helpful for our internal reconciliation.

If thats doable, please send the DocuSign link and well sign and return today.

Erin Walsh

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Erin. Confirming next steps so we can close this out today:

1) Marissa will create the vendor record and send the DocuSign onboarding + Vendor_Onboarding_SLA_v1.docx for signature (expect that within 2 business hours).
2) Once we have signed documents and ACH, Finance will enable the 6-month Net30 accelerated remit pilot at 1% early-pay discount.
3) Ill schedule a 30-minute PO-mapping call (invite to follow) to validate line IDs and the invoice export. Bring a sample CSV export and one example invoice PDF.
4) Marissa will also check with AP about auto-acknowledgement; if PO number is present in the incoming payload we can auto-ack and route. Well confirm final auto-ack behavior on the mapping call.

Ive attached the vendor SLA well send via DocuSign for your records. Thanks again — looking forward to getting FleetOps live.

—Karthik
